onboarding.step2_body: Set the time for your daily reminder.
onboarding.step3_body: Set the duration of your focus session.

settings.title: Settings
settings.random_daily_mantra_subtitle: When enabled, the app picks a different mantra each day instead of your selected one.

mantras.title: Mantras
mantras.random_active_notice: Random mode is active. Turn it off in Settings to choose a fixed mantra.

mantra_1_text:
Every day I think with clarity and confidence.
Abundance begins in my mind.
I recognize the opportunities around me.
I act with determination and discipline.
My effort produces results.
I am building a prosperous life.
mantra_2_text:
I deserve to grow and prosper.
I make intelligent decisions.
I learn from every experience.
My work has value.
Prosperity comes through consistency.
Every day I move closer to my goals.
mantra_3_text:
I am grateful for everything I have.
I value every opportunity.
My gratitude strengthens my vision.
I am ready to grow.
My future is built today.
Abundance follows my effort.
mantra_4_text:
I trust my abilities.
I overcome challenges with serenity.
Every step makes me stronger.
I turn obstacles into opportunities.
My discipline opens new paths.
I am the creator of my own progress.
mantra_5_text:
I act today.
I do not wait for the perfect moment.
Every small action counts.
My consistency produces results.
Success is the result of my habits.
I move forward with decision.
mantra_6_text:
My mind stays focused.
I avoid distractions.
I devote my energy to what matters.
Every decision strengthens my future.
Discipline multiplies my opportunities.
Today I give my best.
mantra_7_text:
My knowledge has value.
My skills grow every day.
I am capable of reaching great goals.
I trust my preparation.
I create opportunities with creativity.
Prosperity follows my growth.
mantra_8_text:
Success is a path.
I enjoy learning and improving.
I persevere even through difficulties.
Every experience makes me stronger.
My commitment produces results.
I am building an abundant life.
mantra_9_text:
I manage my resources wisely.
I spend responsibly.
I save with purpose.
I invest in my growth.
My decisions strengthen my stability.
Prosperity is born from good habits.
mantra_10_text:
Today I choose to think big.
My attitude opens new possibilities.
My effort has a purpose.
I seize every opportunity to grow.
Abundance begins with my actions.
Every day I build a better future.
